draw_fx_graph: draw a torch.fx GraphModule as an SVG or PNG graph visualization file
get_model_info: get a summary string of operation counts and node types from a traced GraphModule
check_acc_op: check whether a torch.fx node or callable target is an acc_ops module function
build_tensor_metadata: build a TensorMetadata object with shape, dtype, stride, and quantization parameters
map_tensor_metadata: recursively map a function over TensorMetadata objects nested in tuples, lists, or dicts
